Author: Maateria
Name: XIVMitigation Plugin
Description: Reads an XIVMitigation plan file and shows an in-game overlay with upcoming spells for your role. Works with plans exported from XIVMitigation (https://xivmitigation.com). Use /xivmit to toggle the overlay, /xivmit config to open settings.
Punchline: Highlights your mitigation spells in real time during fights. Works with xivmitigation.com.
